intro: What's live, what's coming next, and what's further out. Everything here is free for everyone at the table, with no paid tiers.

items.title: Every game
items.detail: Hold'em, Omaha and Omaha Hi-Lo (4, 5 or 6 cards), Seven Card Stud, Stud Hi-Lo, Razz, 2-7 Triple Draw and Badugi, with a How to play guide for each one.

items.title: Game extras, all free
items.detail: Run it twice, straddles, bomb pots, the 7-2 bounty, double board, game rotation, rabbit hunting, the time bank and the Nit game.

items.title: Tournaments that start on their own
items.detail: Schedule one and it starts at the set time, no host click needed. Sit & Gos, recurring events, late registration, rebuys, add-ons, hand-for-hand and custom payouts.

items.title: Tournament formats
items.detail: Bounty and progressive knockout events, invite codes, check-in, and season leaderboards that add up points across nights.

items.title: Finding games
items.detail: The home page lists upcoming and running tournaments. Optional browser alerts, lobby chat, and links that show a nice preview when pasted in WhatsApp.

items.title: Cash game host controls
items.detail: Co-hosts, a waitlist, seat shuffles, spectators with a delay, chat settings and saved table presets.

items.title: Records
items.detail: Ledger with settle-up, hand replayer, your stats, player notes, hand highlights, shareable hand links and full log downloads.

items.title: Table extras
items.detail: Avatars, emotes, show stacks in big blinds, all-in odds, sounds, keep-screen-awake, and install it on your phone like an app.

items.title: Clean felt look
items.detail: A cleaner, flatter table: green felt, crisp cards with big corner letters, and round player badges.

items.title: Practice bots
items.detail: Add a bot to an empty seat to practice a new game risk-free. Each bot gets its own name and robot, like "Ace · John's bot". Bots only sit where a player puts them, never in tournaments.

items.title: Clearer game names
items.detail: Pick the game and the betting limit separately, so tables read like "Hold'em · Pot Limit".

items.title: 8-or-better labels
items.detail: High-low games say plainly when there's a qualifying low and who won each half.

items.title: Cash game reliability
items.detail: A round of fixes so cash games run smoothly from first hand to settle-up.

items.title: Fair-deal proof
items.detail: Every shuffle can be checked afterwards to prove nobody, including the server, could rig the cards.

sections.title: Later
sections.blurb: On the list, roughly in this order.

items.title: Accounts
items.detail: Optional sign-in so your name, stats and settings follow you between devices.

items.title: Tournament polish
items.detail: Smoother host tools and nicer screens for the moments that matter, like the final table.

items.title: The long tail
items.detail: High hand prizes, a final table mode, accessibility improvements and lots of small touches.

items.title: Audio and video
items.detail: Talk and see each other at the table, without a separate app.
